summary: Real-device mobile emulation testing (iPhone UA, hasTouch, isMobile) across 4 viewports (360x640, 375x667, 390x844, 412x915) × 2 themes (dark, light) = 8 sessions. All 12 spec criteria PASS on the primary Hero/Header/Chat/Crest fixes. Body-level horizontal overflow is clean (scrollWidth === innerWidth on all 4 viewports). One residual issue: internal overflow inside #bewertung wizard progress indicator (contained by parent overflow-hidden, so cosmetic only, but should be fixed).

ui_bugs.issue: Internal horizontal overflow on all mobile viewports: a 'flex items-center gap-3' step indicator (with 32px numbered circles and text 'CHF —' etc.) renders at right=506px on a 360-412px viewport. Body does not scroll (parent overflow-hidden clips it), but the rightmost step is visually cut off.
On 360-375px viewports, some card inner content (.flex-1.p-5) extends 15-30px past the viewport right edge. Body scrollWidth stays clean but text/badges inside cards may be visually clipped.

action_items: Optional: make #bewertung step indicator responsive on mobile (flex-wrap or scale down step circles) to eliminate internal 506px overflow. Current parent overflow-hidden hides the impact but rightmost step is visually cut.
critical_code_review_comments: Crest.jsx uses a module-level singleton `crestState` with a pending Promise — correct for avoiding duplicate probes but effectively caches result for the tab lifetime. If wappen.png is later added at runtime it won't be picked up until reload. Acceptable trade-off.
FloatingChat useEffect adds a scroll listener; the 6s fallback timer resolves visibility even if user never scrolls — matches spec.
Hero: stat bar correctly `hidden md:block`, vertical SVG hairline correctly `hidden md:block`. Well-scoped.

success_rate.frontend: 12/12 spec criteria pass (100%), 2 minor internal-overflow issues found in non-hero sections

seed_data_creation: None. /app/frontend/public/brand/ deliberately empty (no wappen.png) to test Crest guard.
test_credentials: not needed (admin /login overflow check was optional and not required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test used real Playwright mobile emulation (iPhone UA + isMobile + hasTouch). Per-viewport-theme fresh context + page.reload() was necessary because Hero uses lazy useState(() => window.innerWidth < 768) and won't re-init on plain viewport resize. Raw per-section JSON at /app/test_reports/iteration_7_raw.json. Chat orb clamp() values confirmed: 360=48, 375=48.8, 390=50.7, 412=53.5.

overlap_matrix.note: Interactive/text overlap check (rect intersection > 100px^2, non-descendant): ZERO overlaps in any section on any viewport/theme combo. All 6 original mobile bugs from customer screenshot are fixed.

rca of the issue: Original bugs from customer screenshot were fixed as follows: (1) Broken wappen — Crest.jsx now uses real Image().onload + naturalWidth>0 verification, returns null on failure; Header renders inline fallback SVG when crest missing. (2) Two-line brand — added whitespace-nowrap + smaller text-[15px] on mobile. (3) Eyebrow overflow — swapped in shorter 'Bodensee · Alpen' text via md:hidden/md:inline pair. (4)+(5) Stat-bar & chat-orb overlapping CTAs — stat bar now hidden md:block (removed from mobile); chat orb starts invisible (scale:0, opacity:0, pointer-events:none) and only reveals after scrollY>120 or 6s idle. (6) Vertical hairline — SVG now hidden md:block. All verified via JS getBoundingClientRect() + getComputedStyle across 8 device combinations.
